               for symbol in self.symbols.values()):

            and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady

+        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
+        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(

+

+        # The entire system is evaluated only when all five daily bars exist.
+        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
+            return
+

+            ticker: data.Bars[symbol].Close

+        }

+        if previous_aapl_close is None:
+            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

+            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+        else:
+            self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+

+            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
+            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
+            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
+        )
+        prior_values_ready = (
+            "SPY" in self.previous_closes
+            and "AAPL" in self.previous_closes
+            and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
+            and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
+        )
+

+            self._evaluate_spy_slot(closes["SPY"])
+            self._evaluate_aapl_slot(closes["AAPL"])
+

+            previous_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
+            and close > sma_200
+        )
+        if crossed_above_200:
+            quantity = self.CalculateOrderQuantity(self.spy, 0.40)

+                self.spy_lot = quantity

+            if self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60:

+            return
